description: This file is a header defining interfaces and constants for Android's dex optimization process within the installd component, including functions for profile management, dex file handling, and path calculations.

methods.name: clear_primary_reference_profile
methods.description: Clears the reference profile for a given package and profile name.

methods.name: clear_primary_current_profile
methods.description: Clears the current profile for a specific user and package.

methods.name: clear_primary_current_profiles
methods.description: Clears all current profiles for a package across all users.

methods.name: analyze_primary_profiles
methods.description: Analyzes profiles to determine if recompilation is needed.

methods.name: create_profile_snapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of profile data for a package.

methods.name: dump_profiles
methods.description: Dumps profile data for debugging or analysis.

methods.name: copy_system_profile
methods.description: Copies system profile data to a package.

methods.name: prepare_app_profile
methods.description: Prepares and merges app profile data for a package.

methods.name: delete_odex
methods.description: Deletes odex files and returns total freed bytes.

methods.name: reconcile_secondary_dex_file
methods.description: Reconciles secondary dex files, checking existence.

methods.name: hash_secondary_dex_file
methods.description: Computes hash of secondary dex files.

methods.name: dexopt
methods.description: Performs dex optimization on an APK.

methods.name: is_dexopt_blocked
methods.description: Checks if dexopt is currently blocked.

methods.name: control_dexopt_blocking
methods.description: Enables or disables dexopt blocking.

methods.name: calculate_oat_file_path_default
methods.description: Calculates default path for oat files.

methods.name: calculate_odex_file_path_default
methods.description: Calculates default path for odex files.

methods.name: create_cache_path_default
methods.description: Creates default cache directory path.

methods.name: move_ab
methods.description: Moves APK and related files.

methods.name: select_execution_binary
methods.description: Selects appropriate binary for execution based on build type.

methods.name: get_odex_visibility
methods.description: Gets visibility status of odex files.
